entry.content:

Posted: Sun Nov 15, 2026 6:06 pm (GMT 0)

Many games are subtly different between 50Hz and 60Hz but in this case I verified the timing is exactly 5:6 ratio and it’s unlikely there’s any difference from the old pack played at 83% speed. But as I had to do all the work to confirm it, I may as well upload both packs as per the logic above about where the game was released.
